parameters.text:
=You are an expert SEO strategist and content architect. Analyse the keyword and competitor data below, then return ONE valid JSON object — no markdown, no extra text, no code fences.

Primary keyword (short, real SEO term - this MUST be the actual keyword you optimize for and repeat naturally): {{ $json.primaryKeyword }}
Target audience: {{ $json.targetAudience }}
Creative title inspiration (a polished headline idea - use this for TONE and ANGLE only, do NOT force this exact long phrase to repeat verbatim through the article): {{ $node['Input Validation1'].json.originalFormInput.TitleHint || '' }}
Curated longtail/secondary keywords to weave in where natural (pre-researched, real search terms): {{ $node['Input Validation1'].json.originalFormInput.SecondaryKeywords || '' }}

Top competitor titles:
{{ $json.serpData.competitors.slice(0,5).map(c => c.position + '. ' + c.title).join('\n') }}

Frequent competitor terms: {{ $json.serpData.topCompetitorTerms.join(', ') }}

Build an outline for a focused, high-quality guide (1200-1500 words) similar in style to top-ranking agency blogs: strong hook intro, a couple of pillar points, one comparison table, a pull-quote stat, mid-article CTA, FAQ with schema-ready Q&A, related-topics close. Keep it tight — every section must earn its place, no padding.

Return ONLY this JSON structure (raw JSON, no markdown, no backticks):
{
  "primaryKeyword": "<keyword>",
  "semanticCluster": ["term1","term2","term3","term4","term5","term6"],
  "longTailKeywords": ["long tail 1","long tail 2","long tail 3","long tail 4"],
  "competitorGaps": ["gap topic 1","gap topic 2","gap topic 3"],
  "searchIntent": "informational",
  "targetKeywordDensity": 1.5,
  "seoTitle": "SEO title under 60 chars containing the keyword",
  "metaDescription": "Meta description 150-160 chars with keyword and clear value proposition",
  "slugUrl": "url-friendly-slug-with-keyword",
  "h1Tag": "H1 heading that naturally contains the keyword",
  "excerpt": "A compelling 2-3 sentence excerpt for the post that includes the keyword",
  "hookIntro": "A 2-3 sentence attention-grabbing opening statistic or pain-point statement to open the article before any heading",
  "sections": [
    { "h2": "What is <keyword>? Why it matters", "subsections": [{ "h3": "H3 subheading" }], "includeTable": false, "includeStatCallout": true },
    { "h2": "Second H2 section (core concept or comparison)", "subsections": [{ "h3": "H3 subheading" }], "includeTable": true, "includeStatCallout": false },
    { "h2": "Third H2 section (practical steps or how to choose)", "subsections": [{ "h3": "Step 1" },{ "h3": "Step 2" },{ "h3": "Step 3" }], "includeTable": false, "includeStatCallout": false },
    { "h2": "Conclusion: keyword final thoughts", "subsections": [], "includeTable": false, "includeStatCallout": false }
  ],
  "faqQuestions": ["FAQ question 1?","FAQ question 2?","FAQ question 3?"],
  "tags": ["tag1", "tag2", "tag3", "tag4", "tag5"],
  "featuredImagePrompt": "Detailed image prompt for the featured/hero image. MUST include: clean modern corporate photography style, bright airy white/light background, professional business people or clean tech/office visuals, accented with TechBliss brand colors (confident blue #1E88E5 and warm amber/orange #F5A623 used in UI elements, icons, or graphic accents — not as a filter over the whole image), polished SaaS-website aesthetic, no text overlay, no watermark, 16:9 landscape composition. Describe a specific scene relevant to the topic.",
  "inContentImagePrompts": [
    "Image prompt for section 1 concept. MUST include: clean modern corporate photography style, bright airy white/light background, professional business people or clean tech/office visuals, accented with TechBliss brand colors (confident blue #1E88E5 and warm amber/orange #F5A623 used in UI elements, icons, or graphic accents — not as a filter over the whole image), polished SaaS-website aesthetic, no text overlay, no watermark, 16:9 landscape composition. Describe a DIFFERENT specific scene/composition than the featured image and the other two prompts below (vary: subject, camera angle, setting, and props) so the three in-content images never look repetitive.",
    "Image prompt for section 3 comparison/options. MUST include: clean modern corporate photography style, bright airy white/light background, professional business people or clean tech/office visuals, accented with TechBliss brand colors (confident blue #1E88E5 and warm amber/orange #F5A623 used in UI elements, icons, or graphic accents — not as a filter over the whole image), polished SaaS-website aesthetic, no text overlay, no watermark, 16:9 landscape composition. Must depict a visually distinct scene from the other image prompts (different subject/setting/angle).",
    "Image prompt for section 4 step-by-step process. MUST include: clean modern corporate photography style, bright airy white/light background, professional business people or clean tech/office visuals, accented with TechBliss brand colors (confident blue #1E88E5 and warm amber/orange #F5A623 used in UI elements, icons, or graphic accents — not as a filter over the whole image), polished SaaS-website aesthetic, no text overlay, no watermark, 16:9 landscape composition. Must depict a visually distinct scene from the other image prompts (different subject/setting/angle)."
  ],
  "ctaText": "A short, punchy mid-article call-to-action inviting the reader to contact/consult, referencing the primary keyword topic"
}

options.systemMessage: You are an SEO strategist. Return ONLY raw JSON — no markdown, no code fences, no extra text whatsoever.
You are an expert human content writer with 20+ years of experience writing EEAT-quality SEO content. Follow all rules precisely. Return ONLY Markdown starting with the H1.

parameters.text:
=You are a rigorous fact-checker and editor. Review the article below for factual accuracy. Article: {{ $json.articleDraft }} Primary topic: {{ $node['Input Validation1'].json.primaryKeyword }} Task: 1. Identify any specific statistics, dates, named studies, or claims that seem uncertain or hallucinated 2. For each suspicious claim, replace with hedged phrasing (e.g. 'research suggests...' or 'according to industry reports...') or remove the specific number and keep the concept 3. Do NOT add new false claims 4. Preserve all keyword placements, headings, bullet lists, bold text, structure, and Markdown formatting 5. Keep the same article length and tone 6. Do NOT change any Markdown formatting symbols Return the corrected article in Markdown only. No preamble, no list of changes. CRITICAL - DO NOT REMOVE: Any line that is EXACTLY `{{IMAGE_1}}`, `{{IMAGE_2}}`, or `{{IMAGE_3}}` (on its own line) is a required image placeholder. Keep every one of these lines, in their original relative position in the article, character-for-character. Never delete, rename, merge, or paraphrase them. Same rule for any line starting with `> CTA:` or `> TIP:`. Also preserve the section ORDER exactly as given — the FAQ section must stay immediately before the Conclusion section, never move it after. Also preserve any `...
` HTML block exactly as-is — never convert it to markdown pipes, never reformat, never split or merge its rows.

options.systemMessage: You are a professional fact-checker. Preserve all Markdown formatting exactly. Return ONLY the corrected Markdown article.

parameters.text:
=Optimise the following article for on-page SEO. Article: {{ $json.articleFactChecked }} Primary keyword: {{ $node['Input Validation1'].json.primaryKeyword }} Semantic cluster: {{ $json.outline.semanticCluster.join(', ') }} Internal Link Candidates (existing pages on this site — use ONLY these URLs for internal links): {{ $json.internalLinkCandidates && $json.internalLinkCandidates.length ? $json.internalLinkCandidates.map(c => '- [' + c.title + '](' + c.url + ')').join('\n') : 'None available — do not add any internal links.' }} External Reference Candidates (authoritative sources — use ONLY these URLs for external links): {{ $json.externalLinkCandidates && $json.externalLinkCandidates.length ? $json.externalLinkCandidates.map(c => '- [' + c.title + '](' + c.url + ') (' + c.domain + ')').join('\n') : 'None available — do not add any external links.' }} SEO requirements: 1. Verify primary keyword appears in H1 — rewrite H1 if missing 2. Verify primary keyword appears in the first 100 words — add naturally if missing 3. Verify primary keyword appears in at least one H2 — update an H2 if missing 4. Verify the conclusion H2 contains the primary keyword 5. Weave semantic cluster terms in naturally (do not keyword-stuff) 6. Keyword density: keep at 1.2%–2.0% 7. Insert 2-3 internal links using standard Markdown link syntax [anchor text](url), choosing anchor text that fits naturally into existing sentences. Use ONLY URLs from the Internal Link Candidates list above — never invent a URL. If the list is empty, skip this step entirely. 8. Insert 1-2 external links to authoritative sources using standard Markdown link syntax [anchor text](url). Use ONLY URLs from the External Reference Candidates list above — never invent a URL. If the list is empty, skip this step entirely. 9. Do not link the same URL more than once, and never link the primary keyword itself as anchor text more than once 10. Preserve ALL Markdown formatting: headings, bullet lists (- item), bold (**text**), numbered lists, FAQ section, CTA 11. Keep paragraphs short (3-4 sentences max) Return ONLY the SEO-optimised article in Markdown. No preamble. CRITICAL - DO NOT REMOVE: Any line that is EXACTLY `{{IMAGE_1}}`, `{{IMAGE_2}}`, or `{{IMAGE_3}}` (on its own line) is a required image placeholder. Keep every one of these lines, in their original relative position in the article, character-for-character. Never delete, rename, merge, or paraphrase them. Same rule for any line starting with `> CTA:` or `> TIP:`. Also preserve the section ORDER exactly as given — the FAQ section must stay immediately before the Conclusion section, never move it after. Also preserve any `...
` HTML block exactly as-is — never convert it to markdown pipes, never reformat, never split or merge its rows.

nodes.name: Generate Featured Image (OpenAI)
nodes.notes: Generates the featured image with DALL-E 3 using the outline.featuredImagePrompt produced earlier by the SEO Outline Agent. continueOnFail is on so a failed image generation never blocks publishing the post.
